# 1. Float Sovereign Consol Bonds (National ADM Cabinet Action; G06-safe: no ai_prerequisite)
oe_fin_cab_issue_sovereign_bonds = {
	ability = adm
	icon = kazenny
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
		current_year >= 1650
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			is_during_bankruptcy = no
		}
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			oe_fin_init_host = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_fin_bonds_cab_active value = 1 }
			oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = { amt = 6 }
		}
	}

	on_deactivate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_bonds_cab_active }
				remove_variable = oe_fin_bonds_cab_active
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		bank_interest = -0.015
		bond_interest = -0.015
		total_loan_capacity_modifier = 0.25
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.06
		monthly_inflation = 0.0003
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.03
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 6 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_loans >= 2 }
				add = { value = 16 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				add = { value = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { inflation >= 0.08 }
				subtract = { value = 22 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Central Bank Bullion Reserve Audit (National ADM Cabinet Action; curbs inflation & bubble heat!)
oe_fin_cab_central_bank_audit = {
	ability = adm
	icon = reduce_inflation
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
		current_year >= 1650
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			oe_fin_init_host = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_fin_audit_cab_active value = 1 }
			oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = { amt = -12 }
			oe_fin_bump_stabilization = { amt = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_deactivate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_fin_audit_cab_active }
				remove_variable = oe_fin_audit_cab_active
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_inflation = -0.0008
		minting_inflation_threshold = 0.06
		bank_interest = -0.010
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = 0.04
		minting_income_factor = -0.15
		trade_income = -0.03
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = -6 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { inflation >= 0.04 }
				add = { value = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_fin_speculative_bubble_crash }
				add = { value = 35 }
			}
		}
	}
}
